agents.verdict: Use concrete scenes as evidence, not repeated props.
agents.recommendation: Let each chat bubble open into a small imagined shared room: kitchen mess, board-game table, rain/cab wait, and final ordinary evening.

agents.verdict: Keep the romance scene on the unspoken emotional request.
agents.recommendation: Stage the tension as distance versus the desire for useless normal time; the message jokes should expose the hidden need to share ordinary life.

agents.verdict: Approve only if the plan avoids one-setting repetition and keeps Zuv active.
agents.recommendation: Block copied text-message frames, all-phone slides, generic long-distance sadness, and any scene where Zuv only receives instead of joining the tiny plan.

options.name: Chat Bubbles Become Shared Rooms
options.case_for: Preserves the reference mechanic while making every message open into a concrete ordinary-life scene.
options.risk: Must not become a copied text-message reel; the imagined scenes need original Aachu/Zuv behavior.

options.name: One Phone, Five Ordinary Plans
options.case_for: Very legible for long-distance couples and keeps the phone as a portal rather than the whole frame.
options.risk: Can feel static if every slide is only a phone screen.

options.name: Pure Chat Screenshot
options.risk: Rejected because it copies the surface format and loses the @a.storyof.two illustrated relationship proof.

selector_verdict: Chat Bubbles Become Shared Rooms wins because it keeps the viral text-message familiarity, but every bubble becomes an original imagined ordinary-life scene where Aachu and Zuv both want the same boring time.
hard_fails_checked: no copied chat screenshot or exact reference text
story evidence must prove slide copy
no repeated object motif across every slide

final_visual_plan.copy: If there was no long distance...
final_visual_plan.visual: Aachu and Zuv are apart in two soft phone-lit corners, each holding a phone, with tiny imagined ordinary scenes beginning to appear between them; distance is the obstacle, not the aesthetic.

final_visual_plan.copy:
"We should cook together."
"That's a terrible idea."
"Exactly."
final_visual_plan.visual: Inside the imagined shared room from the chat, Aachu and Zuv stand at a tiny kitchen counter with flour, a messy pot, and two phones nearby; Aachu is animated about the plan and Zuv joins the bad idea with a warm amused reply.

final_visual_plan.copy:
"Board game night?"
"Only if you don't invent rules after losing."
final_visual_plan.visual: Aachu and Zuv sit across an imagined board-game table with dice, tiny colored tokens, and exaggerated competitive faces; Zuv teases gently about her invented rules while still clearly wanting the whole scene with her.

final_visual_plan.copy:
"Cab is 12 minutes late."
"Best news all day."
final_visual_plan.visual: Rainy imagined pickup scene: Aachu and Zuv wait under one umbrella beside a small cab-app phone screen; instead of frustration, both look quietly relieved, and Zuv's reply admits he wants the extra minutes too.

final_visual_plan.copy:
"Maybe I don't miss big dates."
"Maybe I just miss wasting normal time with you."
final_visual_plan.visual: Final warm-paper room where the earlier kitchen, board-game, and cab icons soften into one ordinary shared evening; Aachu and Zuv sit close with phones lowered, proving the point is not the plans but wanting normal time together.
